correctness.rationale: The inspected archival source states the exact Pluecker degree formula and its rectangular standard-tableau interpretation. The Schubert affine-cell decomposition gives exactly binomial(n,k) cells, hence the Euler characteristic. For k=2 the degree is Catalan and the exact normalized adjacent ratio is strictly increasing from n=4 onward, with values 14/15 at n=6 and 2 at n=7. For k>=3, a direct factorial quotient shows that degree is nondecreasing toward the center. The k=3 degree starts at 42>20 for n=6 and grows by a factor greater than 2 at every subsequent n, while the central binomial coefficient grows by a factor at most 2. These symbolic inequalities prove the classification and exclude equality for all parameters. The bundled checker replays every product and ratio over a broad finite range.

value.rationale: Grassmannians are foundational projective homogeneous varieties. Their Pluecker degree counts a generic complementary linear section, while their Euler characteristic counts Schubert cells. The theorem gives the complete ordering of these two canonical complexities across every Grassmannian, isolates the three non-projective exceptions up to duality, and proves there are no equality cases. The exact degree-ratio argument also explains why the transition is permanent once one leaves the small two-plane edge.
